name: pspg
summary: Tabular data pager for psql, mysql, sqlite and other database shells, with frozen columns and sorting
description: pspg is a pager built for query results. Point psql, mysql, sqlite3, pgcli, usql or nushell at it and you can freeze the first rows and columns while scrolling, sort by a numeric column, search, select and copy a block to the clipboard, and switch between many colour themes. Mouse support included. It runs anywhere less would.
